sourceTitle: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
sourceAbstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrA I309A/E330V ) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroA R27A/K38A ) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.
titleZh: 以多层次代谢工程提高解淀粉芽孢杆菌的L-酪氨酸产量
abstractZh: L-酪氨酸是一种用途广泛的高价值芳香族氨基酸。虽然基于质粒的过表达已经明显提高了L-酪氨酸产量，但依赖抗生素筛选，以及在非选择性条件下存在遗传不稳定性，限制了其工业应用。为解决这些问题，本研究采用多层次代谢工程策略，在解淀粉芽孢杆菌（Bacillus amyloliquefaciens）的基因组层面增强L-酪氨酸生物合成途径。首先，将含有突变型预苯酸脱氢酶TyrA（I309A/E330V）的表达盒插入野生型菌株Z1的基因组。当拷贝数达到3个时，所得菌株Z4的L-酪氨酸滴度达到437.43 mg/L。随后整合突变型DAHP合酶AroA（R27A/K38A），所得双拷贝菌株Z7的L-酪氨酸滴度提高至591.29 mg/L。对限速步骤的系统性辨识表明，大多数途径基因都能不同程度地提高产量。接着，研究者通过启动子原位替换构建菌株Z21，使滴度进一步提高到813.01 mg/L。最后，通过优化前体供应，工程菌株Z32的L-酪氨酸滴度达到1079.94 mg/L。总体而言，这一无质粒、不依赖抗生素的平台，为微生物细胞工厂稳定生物合成L-酪氨酸及其他芳香族氨基酸提供了一种有前景的策略。

sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for higher fatty alcohol production
sourceAbstract: Fatty alcohols are versatile chemicals with growing demand across a broad range of industries, yet conventional production methods pose environmental challenges. Microbial biosynthesis offers a promising alternative, if hosts can be engineered to achieve high product titers. The industrially relevant oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica is well suited to this challenge because of its natural capacity for lipid metabolism. Here, we engineered Y. lipolytica W29 for fatty alcohol production by disrupting pathways involved in lipogenesis and fatty alcohol oxidation, identifying fatty alcohol oxidation as a major constraint on product accumulation. Initial engineering yielded fatty alcohol titers of 2.5 g/L from 40 g/L glucose. Subsequent optimization of media supplements and nutrient concentrations, combined with deletion of the citrate transporter CEX1 and addition of 1% Tergitol to the extractive culture medium, increased titers to 10.9 g/L in shake flasks with 80 g/L glucose and a carbon-to-nitrogen ratio of 60. Scaling the process to fed-batch bioreactor cultivation further increased titers to 19.4 g/L. These results demonstrate that combining metabolic engineering with medium and process optimization enables high-titer fatty alcohol production in Y. lipolytica . Highlights Increased fatty alcohol titers by disrupting lipogenesis, fatty alcohol oxidation, and citrate export Dodecane and Tergitol addition increased flask fermentation titers to 10.7 g/L Fed-batch fermentation in bioreactors was performed with Tergitol to 19.4 g/L
titleZh: 通过代谢工程提高解脂耶氏酵母的脂肪醇产量
abstractZh:
脂肪醇是用途广泛的化学品，众多行业对其需求不断增长，但传统生产方法带来环境方面的挑战。如果能够通过宿主工程实现较高的产物滴度，微生物生物合成便是一种有前景的替代途径。具有工业应用价值的产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）天然具备脂质代谢能力，因而适合承担这一任务。本研究对Y. lipolytica W29进行工程改造，通过破坏参与脂质合成和脂肪醇氧化的途径来生产脂肪醇，并确定脂肪醇氧化是限制产物积累的主要因素。初步改造后，使用40 g/L葡萄糖时，脂肪醇滴度达到2.5 g/L。随后，研究者优化培养基添加物及营养成分浓度，结合删除柠檬酸转运蛋白基因CEX1，并在萃取培养基中加入1% Tergitol，使摇瓶培养在80 g/L葡萄糖、碳氮比60的条件下，脂肪醇滴度提高至10.9 g/L。将工艺放大到补料分批生物反应器培养后，滴度进一步提高至19.4 g/L。这些结果表明，将代谢工程与培养基及工艺优化相结合，能够实现解脂耶氏酵母中脂肪醇的高滴度生产。

研究亮点（Highlights）：
通过破坏脂质合成、脂肪醇氧化和柠檬酸外排，提高脂肪醇滴度。
加入十二烷和Tergitol使摇瓶发酵滴度提高至10.7 g/L。
在添加Tergitol的生物反应器中开展补料分批发酵，滴度达到19.4 g/L。
sourceNote: 原接口当前摘要的正文报告摇瓶滴度为10.9 g/L，Highlights中写为10.7 g/L；译文按各自位置保留原值，未独立核实这一差异的原因。
